A lightweight text-to-cell projector then transforms this intermediate embedding into a soft prompt for the scLLM. The scLLM then predicts a pseudo-cell expression vector x ′ = scGPT ( c ′ ) ∈ R M .
We conduct cell generation experiments on the immune tissue [60] dataset.
